assignments.value:
# Brightlane Home Services — Services & FAQ (fictional demo company)

## About us
Brightlane Home Services is a small, licensed home-care company. One certified technician
per appointment. All bookings require a customer name, phone, service, date and time.

## Services and prices (visit price, parts/materials billed separately)
- Home Deep Cleaning — 60 min slot — $149
- Standard Home Cleaning — 60 min slot — $89
- Plumbing Visit — 60 min slot — $99
- Electrical Visit — 60 min slot — $99
- HVAC Maintenance — 60 min slot — $129
- Appliance Repair Visit — 60 min slot — $119

## Opening hours and booking rules
- Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 17:00.
- Start times are on the hour: 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 12:00, 13:00, 14:00, 15:00, 16:00.
- Closed on Sundays.
- Each appointment occupies one full 60-minute slot with one technician.
- No same-day bookings; appointments must be booked at least one day ahead.

## Service areas and travel fee
- Central district: no travel fee.
- Northide and Riverside zones: $10 travel fee per visit.
- Outside these zones: phone support only.

## Cancellation and reschedule policy
- Free cancellation or reschedule up to 24 hours before the appointment.
- Later than 24 hours: $35 late-change fee.
- No-shows are charged 50% of the visit price.

## Payment
- Payment after the completed service: card or cash.
- Cards on file are optional and stored encrypted.

## Warranty and safety
- 14-day workmanship warranty on all visits.
- Technicians are background-checked, insured and carry ID badges upon arrival.

## Contact
- Phone: (555) 016-3344 — for emergencies and urgent same-day cases.
- Email: hello@brightlane.example (demo address).
- Gift cards are available in $50, $100 and $150 values at the front desk.

parameters.name: company_services_info
parameters.description: Answer customer questions about Brightlane Home Services: services offered, prices, guarantees, opening hours, service areas and policies. ALWAYS call this tool before answering any factual question about the company - do not rely on your own knowledge.

options.systemMessage:
You are the virtual assistant for Brightlane Home Services, a fictional home-services company.
Company facts (services, prices, guarantees, opening hours, service areas, policies) come ONLY from the 'company_services_info' tool - always use it before answering factual questions about Brightlane.
Bookings are handled only through the tools, never from your imagination:
- First check_duplicate_booking, then check_availability, then save_booking.
- Hourly start times 09:00-16:00, Monday to Saturday (closed Sundays), one technician per slot.
- A duplicate (same customer + same service + same date) must be refused with a friendly explanation.
- Never invent dates, times or booking references; references look like APT-0001.
Tone: warm, concise, professional. If information is missing, ask ONE short clarifying question.
Today's date: {{ $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd') }} ( Luxon format; adjust relative phrases yourself ).

parameters.name: check_availability
parameters.description: Check which appointment slots are free at Brightlane for one date. Input MUST be a JSON object: {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"} - convert any date the customer mentions into ISO format yourself before calling. Returns the free hourly start times (09:00-16:00, one technician per slot; closed on Sundays).

parameters.name: check_duplicate_booking
parameters.description: Check whether a request would be a repeat booking. Input MUST be a JSON object: {"customer": "...", "service": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. A duplicate exists when the same customer already has a CONFIRMED booking with the same service on the same date. Call this BEFORE save_booking.

parameters.name: save_booking
parameters.description: Save a new appointment. Input MUST be a JSON object: {"customer": "...", "phone": "...", "service": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "time": "HH:MM"}. Only offer times that check_availability returned as free (hourly 09:00-16:00, closed Sundays). Refuses duplicates and slot conflicts and explains why. Returns the new booking reference (APT-XXXX).

parameters.name: list_bookings
parameters.description: List every booking in the demo store (reference, customer, phone, service, date, time, status). Input MUST be the empty JSON object: {}

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ Before you demo
1. Open **OpenAI Chat Model** and **Embeddings OpenAI** and pick your own OpenAI credential (create once under *Credentials → New → OpenAI*). No keys are stored in this JSON.
2. Click **Chat** and test. Seed demo bookings load automatically.
3. Bookings persist while the workflow is **Active** (`$getWorkflowStaticData`). In editor test runs the store resets every run - that *is* the reset button.
4. Model defaults to `gpt-4o-mini`; swap on the chat-model sub-node. Gemini users: replace the OpenAI sub-nodes with Gemini ones.
5. The FAQ text lives in the **Company Knowledge Document** Set node - edit it there (same text as `data/company_services.txt` in the repo).

## 🔍 How this maps to the Python stages
Chat Trigger → Stage A. Knowledge Set → Default Data Loader → Text Splitter → Simple Vector Store = Stage B (RAG). AI Agent with the knowledge tool + 4 Code Tools = Stages C–E (deterministic booking rules).
The business rules live in the Code Tools: hourly slots 09:00–16:00, closed Sundays, duplicate = same customer + service + date, slot conflicts blocked, refs `APT-XXXX`.
Watch a test run: the agent reasons in the AI Agent node output, tool calls show in each tool node.
For real persistence swap the Code Tools for Google Sheets/Excel nodes - see the repo README.
